purpose: Execute the atomic revolve-profile operation within the MA-08 boundary: One root-part planar-face revolution through the V21 RevolveFaces.Execute command and an in-memory Line axis. It does not construct a profile, discover faces, attach a transient body, save, or infer source-sheet consumption from command return order.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires revolve-profile and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: profile_face
inputs.description: A current planar face that is the only face of an open root-part sheet body.

inputs.name: axis_origin_mm
inputs.description: Finite point on the revolution axis in millimetres.

inputs.name: axis_direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero revolution-axis direction; normalized by the shared direction helper.

inputs.name: angle_degrees
inputs.description: Signed nonzero revolution angle in degrees, limited to absolute value at most 360; converted to radians for V21.

inputs.name: section_policy
inputs.description: How the caller wants source-face lifecycle checked. kernel-managed records counts without guessing kernel behavior; preserve and consume assert the requested result. Default: "kernel-managed".

preconditions: profile_face is current, planar, and the only face of one open root sheet body.
axis_origin_mm and axis_direction are finite and axis_direction is nonzero.
angle_degrees is finite, nonzero, and within plus or minus 360 degrees.
section_policy is kernel-managed, preserve, or consume.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: current root DesignBody, section_policy: string, source_count_before: integer, source_count_after: integer}; body is the unique newly detected closed positive-volume solid.

postconditions: RevolveFaces.Execute is called with a Line axis, a radians-converted angle, ExtrudeType.ForceIndependent, and PullSymmetric false.
After re-enumerating current root bodies, exactly one new closed positive-volume body is detected after sheet owners are excluded.
kernel-managed reports source_count_before and source_count_after without asserting either lifecycle; preserve requires the source face count to remain one and consume requires it to become zero.

implementation.notes: Execute the atomic revolve-profile operation within the MA-08 boundary: One root-part planar-face revolution through the V21 RevolveFaces.Execute command and an in-memory Line axis. It does not construct a profile, discover faces, attach a transient body, save, or infer source-sheet consumption from command return order. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Root bodies are enumerated before and after the mutating command; topology references must be reacquired after success.

failure_modes.detection: Face ownership, planar-sheet, axis, angle, or policy validation fails before the command call.

failure_modes.condition: RevolveFaces.Execute reports failure, raises, or no unique new closed positive-volume body is found.
failure_modes.detection: RevolveFaces.Execute reports failure, raises, or no unique new closed positive-volume body is found.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

failure_modes.condition: The requested preserve/consume policy does not match the post-command source-face count.
failure_modes.detection: The requested preserve/consume policy does not match the post-command source-face count.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate the current root face and supply a valid planar sheet plus a finite nonzero axis and angle; no command mutation is expected.
Treat the root document as potentially partially mutated, inspect/reopen a clean run-owned copy, and rerun only after axis/profile feasibility is diagnosed; no rollback is implemented.
Stop and record the kernel lifecycle; use kernel-managed for an explicitly unasserted variant or rerun from a clean copy with a supported policy.
